subject: Creative attribution waiver for enterprise renewal incentive
messages:
From: Diego Morales <diego.morales@nimbushealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Opportunity: case study / logo + creative use in exchange for renewal credit

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is impressed with the latency numbers. We have an internal renewal conversation next month and there’s appetite to include Redwood in an upcoming partner showcase and a short case study.

Before we can commit, Legal at Nimbus needs to confirm the exact wording, logo usage, and whether there will be any attribution placed in press materials. In parallel, our procurement team is asking whether Redwood would be willing to provide a one-time renewal credit (we quoted a 15% discount in the renewal estimate) in exchange for a 12-month co-marketing commitment: logo on partner page, a short case study (600–800 words), and permission to use a 15–20 second customer quote in promotional video.

Can you confirm what level of publicity/attribution we would require for a credit of this size and whether there are any non-standard legal terms we would need (e.g., exclusivity, royalty, advance approval on every asset)? I can share Nimbus’s standard MSA appendix if helpful.

Appreciate a quick read — timing is tight.

Best,
Diego
Director, Platform Partnerships
Nimbus Health

Attachments: nimbus_brand_guidelines.pdf
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Opportunity: case study / logo + creative use in exchange for renewal credit

Folks — forwarding Diego’s note from Nimbus. Short ask: they want to trade a public case study + logo/video quote for a one-time renewal credit (~15%). Legal is asking about attribution rights and whether we ever require royalties/exclusivity.

Proposed deal team position: accept logo + short case study + a pre-approved 20s quote with explicit review rights and up to two rounds of copy edits. No exclusivity, no royalties, and a standard publicity release (signed). In exchange, authorize a one-time 12% renewal credit (below the 15% they’re asking). We can offer the additional 3% as a conditional uplift if Nimbus agrees to a 12-month joint webinar and a partner page feature.

Questions for approval: 1) Is 12% one-time credit acceptable for revenue/finance? 2) Any legal objections to the proposed publicity language (we’d need approval to use name/logo and a short quote; we’d pre-clear each asset)? 3) Any marketing constraints (e.g., can we put Nimbus on homepage hero if they request)?

I’ve attached the current proposal and a mock testimonial snippet we’d ask them to sign off on.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf, proposed_testimonial_snippet.docx
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Opportunity: case study / logo + creative use in exchange for renewal credit

On 2026-10-03 11:06, aditya_rao wrote:
> Folks — forwarding Diego’s note from Nimbus. Short ask: they want to trade a public case study + logo/video quote for a one-time renewal credit (~15%). Legal is asking about attribution rights and whether we ever require royalties/exclusivity.

Thanks for the summary. My quick take: 12% one-time credit seems reasonable if there’s measurable marketing commitment and a signed publicity release that limits our obligation to review/approve content within a fixed window (e.g., 3 business days per asset). We should not agree to any exclusivity or royalty payments.

Need finance sign-off on the final number (monica — are you okay with 12% and the conditional extra 3% tied to webinar/feature?). Also loop in Legal Ops for a short release template — we shouldn’t overcomplicate with a bespoke royalty clause. If Legal asks for brand usage restrictions, we honor their guidelines (Nimbus brand guidelines attached) and get a final approved asset before publishing.

One additional ask from me: add a clause that allows us to remove the case study/quote after 12 months if Nimbus requests it, with no penalty — keeps things reversible if either party changes strategy.

- Vivek
SVP, Sales Operations
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Opportunity: case study / logo + creative use in exchange for renewal credit

On Oct 3, 2026, at 1:02 PM, vivek_kulkarni wrote:
> Need finance sign-off on the final number (monica — are you okay with 12% and the conditional extra 3% tied to webinar/feature?).

I can approve 12% one-time credit against the renewal contract as a sales concession, provided: 1) the customer signs our standard publicity release (no royalties, no exclusivity), 2) the conditional +3% is explicitly tied to completion of a co-hosted webinar and a partner page placement within 90 days of renewal, and 3) the marketing deliverables are defined in the MAP (mutual action plan) with acceptance criteria.

Finance will need the credit to be booked to marketing expense (Co-Marketing Fund) and we’ll require the legal/publicity release to be attached to the deal for audit. Monica (Finance Ops) will own accounting entry; please add the doc link to the deal record.

Given those constraints, I approve the concession. Laura — can you draft the publicity release template with the removal clause Vivek suggested?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Deal Desk (Finance & Revenue Operations)

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Diego Morales <diego.morales@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity: case study / logo + creative use in exchange for renewal credit

Hi Diego — great to align. Thank you for sharing the brand guidelines.

Short version: Redwood can move forward with a one-time 12% renewal credit in exchange for: a) a 600–800 word case study, b) permission to use Nimbus logo on our partner page, and c) a pre-approved 15–20 second customer quote for promotional video use. No exclusivity or royalties.

We’ll require a signed publicity release (we’ll send our standard template) and we request up to two rounds of edits on copy and up to three small creative tweaks on video timestamps. We also include a clause that allows either party to request removal of the published assets after 12 months with no penalty.

If Nimbus is willing to commit to a co-hosted webinar and partner page placement within 90 days of renewal, we will extend the credit to 15% (conditional). Please send the name and email of the legal contact so our legal ops can exchange the release.

Next steps: 1) You confirm acceptance of the terms above. 2) We’ll attach the signed publicity release to the deal and book the credit to Co-Marketing Fund. 3) Laura will share the release template and the testimonial snippet for Nimbus to approve.

Looking forward — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf
